canada.title: Montreal police, BEI investigating after 18-year-old cyclist killed in hit-and-run collision
canada.summary: Montreal police are investigating after an 18-year-old cyclist was killed in a hit-and-run collision in the city's Ahuntsic-Cartierville borough on Friday.

canada.title: Some Western Canadians adjusting to time differences, despite clocks not changing
canada.summary: The clocks aren't changing Sunday in the western half of the country, but that doesn't mean changes aren't coming as British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, northwestern Ontario and the Northwest Territories all chose this year to stick with daylight time.

canada.title: Woman facing impaired driving charge in 3-vehicle crash in Etobicoke
canada.summary: A 40-year-old woman is facing impaired driving charges following a three-vehicle crash in Etobicoke on Sunday.

canada.title: Pedestrian, 19, dead after early morning collision at Winnipeg intersection
canada.summary: A 19-year-old pedestrian has died after she was struck by a minivan in an industrial zone in Winnipeg's St. Boniface area on Saturday morning.

canada.title: Big Jim MacLellan, 92, remembered as six-decade pillar of Men of the Deeps
canada.summary: Big Jim MacLellan, from Glace Bay, N.S., was a coal-miner-turned-mine manager best known for his six-decade involvement with The Men of the Deeps choir. The 92-year-old died Friday and is being remembered for the monologues he delivered about the lives of Cape Breton miners and their communities.

canada.title: N.L. to open 72 new child-care spaces in St. John's health hub with hopes of retaining workers
canada.summary: The government of Newfoundland and Labrador announced on Friday it's creating 72 more child-care spaces for health-care workers at the Unity Health Centre on Stavanger Drive in St. John’s.

canada.title: Multiple reports of cocaine contaminated with fentanyl found on opposite sides of N.L., warns health authority
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador Health Services (NLHS) is warning the public about multiple reports of cocaine suspected to be contaminated with fentanyl in the eastern and Labrador-Grenfell areas of the province.

canada.title: Teenager dead, 2 seriously injured after collision near Bassano, Alta., RCMP say
canada.summary: A teenager died in a two-vehicle collision in southern Alberta shortly after midnight Sunday, RCMP say.

canada.title: N.S. court orders more detailed allegations in $10M illegal lobster lawsuit
canada.summary: A Nova Scotia court has ordered a commercial fishing group seeking $10 million in damages related to alleged illegal lobster buying to name names and provide more details about its allegations.

canada.title: PM Carney announces by-elections in Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced on Sunday that there will be by-elections in some Ontario, Quebec and Saskatchewan federal districts at the end of the year.

canada.title: Proposed data centre would release ‘23 Hiroshima-sized atomic bombs worth of energy’ a day, physicist says
canada.summary: An analysis of the mammoth Wonder Valley data centre suggests it would release the equivalent of 23 atom bombs of heat waste into the boreal forest of northwestern Alberta every day. A Utah State University physicist who conducted the review for the Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation said the project demands a full environmental impact assessment.

canada.title: Free game lets you explore B.C.'s mountain trails
canada.summary: Budapest-based software engineer Greg Kovács has created Bonvo.ski, a free interactive 3D browser game and mapping platform that renders thousands of ski resorts across the globe — including B.C. destinations from Whistler, Big White, Apex and Fernie.

canada.title: Major wagers placed on B.C. elections amid prediction markets' growing influence
canada.summary: Hundreds of thousands of dollars were on the line as platforms like Polymarket and Kalshi took wagers on the outcomes of the provincial vote and various mayoral contests across the province.

canada.title: Whitehorse man on mission to map city's 'under-documented and under-explored' mining history
canada.summary: Tim Green has been using hand-drawn maps from the early 1900s along with modern geospatial technology to make a map of his own to explore and discover remnants of mining and exploration efforts in Whitehorse.

canada.title: Once a derelict basement, youth-led safe space comes to life with free programming
canada.summary: Sam Woodrow remembers seeing the radical transformation of a youth-led space from Big Brothers Big Sisters of the Battlefords firsthand, as it changed from rumours of a haunted house to a safe place to hang out.

canada.title: A city between flights: How Moose Jaw is holding on to the Snowbirds
canada.summary: Moose Jaw's fight to keep the Snowbirds flying continues even after the squadron's final air show.

canada.title: Sophie K’ea laid to rest at home in Behchokǫ̀, bringing closure and healing for family
canada.summary: Sophie K’ea was only 7 years old when she died at the St. Joseph's Residential School in Fort Resolution, N.W.T. Now, she’s been laid to rest back home in Behchokǫ̀, buried next to family.

canada.title: Group gets people with Parkinson’s disease dancing
canada.summary: Studies have shown that dance has positive impact on Parkinson's disease, a degenerative disease where symptoms get worse over time.
